name: Screen/Server Detail — Settings · Lifecycle (Wake on connect unavailable)

children.name: h
children.content: When off, the StatefulSet is scaled to zero (Suspended). Data is preserved.

children.name: h
children.content: Seconds the operator waits for the template’s stop sequence to finish before scaling the pod down. Range 0–600; defaults to 30. No effect when the template declares no stop sequence.

children.name: h
children.content: Per-server overrides for the template’s readiness/liveness/startup probe timing. The probe action is inherited from the template.

children.name: h
children.content: Scale the server to zero when nobody is playing, and bring it back on a schedule or on demand. The world is saved first and the data volume is kept.

children.name: Switch Label
children.content: Wake the server when a player connects

children.name: Helper
children.content: Not available for this game: its template marks every port as unable to wake the server.
A game that reports no player count will never sleep.
A wake window never restarts a server you stopped by hand.
